title: Portfolio adviser to the super-rich wanted a bigger stock market correction. Here's why
summary: A wealth adviser at Citi views market corrections as buying opportunities for high-net-worth clients rather than losses. The perspective reflects how affluent investors approach volatility strategically, contrasting with average investor sentiment. It highlights divergent wealth management philosophies during periods of market uncertainty.
content: Citi Wealth would have welcomed a deeper stock-market correction this year, seeing any bigger pullback as an opportunity to buy.

zh.title: 为超富人群提供建议的投资顾问希望股市出现更大幅度调整。原因如下
zh.summary: 花旗银行的财富顾问将市场调整视为高净值客户的买入机会，而非损失。这一观点反映出富有投资者如何战略性地应对市场波动，与普通投资者的情绪形成对比。它突出了市场不确定时期财富管理理念的差异。

title: Stock futures rise as traders eye elevated Treasury yields, brace for jobs report due this week: Live updates
summary: Stock futures are rising as investors assess elevated Treasury yields and brace for key employment data this week. Markets are navigating mixed signals from softer inflation readings and uncertainty about Federal Reserve rate direction. The upcoming jobs report is expected to influence Fed policy decisions.
content: Investors are weighing a softer inflation picture, higher Treasury yields and uncertainty over the Fed's next rate decision.

zh.title: 股指期货上升，交易员关注国债收益率上升，为本周就业报告做准备：实时更新
zh.summary: 随着投资者评估国债收益率上升并为本周关键就业数据做准备，股指期货正在上升。市场在应对通胀数据较弱和美联储利率方向不确定的混合信号。即将发布的就业报告预计将影响美联储的政策决定。

title: AI boom could trigger market shocks, Bank of England boss warns
summary: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey warns that massive cash flows into artificial intelligence investments could trigger market instability. The central bank is closely monitoring AI funding trends to identify systemic risks and potential bubbles. The warning reflects growing concern about whether AI valuations have become unsustainable.
content: Andrew Bailey says the central bank is watching the waves of cash being invested in artificial intelligence "very carefully".

zh.title: 英格兰银行行长警告人工智能热潮可能引发市场冲击
zh.summary: 英格兰银行行长安德鲁·贝利警告，大量资金流入人工智能投资可能引发市场不稳定。央行密切监控人工智能融资趋势，以识别系统性风险和潜在泡沫。这一警告反映出人们对人工智能估值是否已变得不可持续的日益关注。

title: South Korean President Lee pushes back on Alaska LNG project after Trump touts Seoul's participation
summary: South Korean President Lee has expressed doubts about Seoul's participation in the Alaska LNG project despite U.S. announcements of $200 billion in Korean investment. Seoul has not finalized commitment to the energy infrastructure project. The disagreement signals diplomatic tension over major international investments.
content: The U.S. announced plans for up to $200 billion in South Korean investment, though Seoul has yet to finalize the participation in the Alaska LNG project.

zh.title: 韩国总统李尹锡在特朗普称赞首尔参与阿拉斯加液化天然气项目后表示反对
zh.summary: 尽管美国宣布向韩国投资2000亿美元，韩国总统李尹锡对首尔参与阿拉斯加液化天然气项目表示了怀疑。首尔还未最终确定对该能源基础设施项目的承诺。这种分歧表明了对重大国际投资的外交紧张关系。

title: In photos: China's Xi hardens Taiwan warning as country celebrates week-long National Day holiday
summary: During China's National Day celebrations, President Xi Jinping reinforced Beijing's hardened stance on Taiwan in his annual speech. The messaging signals continued pressure on the self-governed island amid persistent diplomatic tensions. Xi's comments reflect ongoing disputes despite established protocols.
content: China began its seven-day National Day holiday on Thursday after President Xi Jinping used his annual speech to sharpen Beijing's message on Taiwan.

zh.title: 图片报道：中国领导人习近平在国庆假期期间强硬对台警告
zh.summary: 在中国国庆庆祝活动期间，习近平主席在年度演讲中加强了北京对台湾的强硬立场。这一表态在持续的外交紧张中向自治岛屿施加了继续的压力。习近平的评论反映了尽管有既定协议但持续存在的争端。

title: Cars have become unaffordable for many Americans. Here’s what the numbers show.
summary: Used vehicles now exceed traditional affordability thresholds for many American consumers when accounting for current prices and interest rates. Rising car costs and financing rates have priced out substantial portions of the car-buying population. The data demonstrates significant deterioration in automobile accessibility across income levels.
content: At today’s prices and rates, even the average used vehicle can exceed some commonly used affordability measures.

zh.title: 汽车对许多美国人来说已成为奢侈品。数据显示了什么
zh.summary: 在考虑当前价格和利率的情况下，二手车价格现已超过了许多美国消费者的传统可承受范围。上升的汽车成本和融资利率已经将大部分买车人群挤出市场。数据显示了汽车在各收入水平上的可获得性显著恶化。

title: AI race heats up as OpenAI flags alleged model-copying campaign
summary: OpenAI disclosed an alleged attempt to extract protected reasoning technology from its AI models, with some activity attributed to China's Moonshot AI. The incident underscores intensifying competition and security concerns in advanced AI development. It highlights the escalating stakes in the race for AI leadership.
content: OpenAI says it identified an attempt to extract protected reasoning from its AI models, linking part of the activity with China’s Moonshot AI.

zh.title: 随着OpenAI标记涉嫌模型复制活动,AI竞争升温
zh.summary: OpenAI披露了一起涉嫌试图从其AI模型中提取受保护推理技术的事件,部分活动被归因于中国的Moonshot AI。该事件凸显了高级AI开发中日益激烈的竞争和安全隐忧。这突出了AI领导力竞争中日益升高的赌注。

title: Trump’s AI lunch included every major tech company. Except Apple
summary: Apple notably did not attend Trump's AI policy meeting with major technology companies, sparking speculation about its positioning on government initiatives. The absence highlights Apple's independent business strategy regardless of administration priorities. Apple typically pursues its own interests in policy discussions.
content: Apple's absence from Trump's AI lunch raised eyebrows, but the company is known to look out for its own interests.

zh.title: 特朗普的AI午餐包括所有主要科技公司,除了苹果
zh.summary: 苹果明显没有出席特朗普与主要科技公司的AI政策会议,引发了对其在政府举措中立场的猜测。缺席凸显了苹果不顾行政当局优先事项的独立业务战略。苹果通常在政策讨论中追求自己的利益。

title: Passengers and crew foil co-pilot's apparent attempt to crash FlyDubai flight to Israel
summary: A co-pilot on a FlyDubai flight to Israel stabbed the second pilot in an apparent attempt to crash the aircraft, according to Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu. Passengers and crew members intervened to prevent a potential disaster. The incident raises serious questions about cockpit security and personnel screening.
content: One of the pilots on a FlyDubai flight headed for Israel stabbed the second pilot, according to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

zh.title: 乘客和机组人员挫败副驾驶员明显的坠毁FlyDubai飞往以色列航班的企图
zh.summary: 据以色列总理内塔尼亚胡称,FlyDubai飞往以色列航班的一名副驾驶员刺伤了二副驾驶员,试图坠毁飞机。乘客和机组人员进行了干预,防止了潜在灾难。该事件引发了对驾驶舱安全和人员筛选的严重质疑。

title: Inside India newsletter: Foreign insurers get the red-carpet treatment — and policy uncertainty
summary: Foreign insurance companies are receiving favorable market treatment in India while navigating uncertain regulatory conditions. The mixed signals create both opportunities and challenges for international insurers expanding into the market. India's policy approach to foreign insurance participation remains volatile.
content: Foreign insurers brace for another set of policy changes in India's insurance market.

zh.title: 印度内部通讯：外国保险公司获得红毯待遇——及政策不确定性
zh.summary: 外国保险公司在印度获得优惠的市场待遇，同时应对不确定的监管条件。这些混合信号为国际保险公司进入市场既创造了机遇，也带来了挑战。印度对外资保险参与的政策立场仍不稳定。
